View a PDF of the paper titled Probabilistic smooth attention for deep multiple instance learning in medical imaging, by Francisco M. > Abstract:The Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) paradigm is attracting plenty of attention in medical imaging classification, where labeled data is scarce. However, they treat attention values deterministically, potentially overlooking uncertainty in the contribution of individual instances.
